newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Democratic Congo's Kabila off to Angola - state TV.
newsitem.headline: Democratic Congo's Kabila off to Angola - state TV.

text.p: President Laurent Kabila left the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Tuesday for an official visit to neighbouring Angola, state television reported.
The visit had not been previously announced and the television gave no indication of its duration.
Kabila's ministers for the economy, interior and telecommunications had flown to Luanda earlier, it said.
Angola, along with Rwanda and Uganda, were Kabila's key allies during his seven-month guerrilla campaign in the former Zaire that toppled veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko in mid-May.
In a separate development, an official German delegation arrived in Kinshasa on Tuesday for talks on aid to Kabila's government, officials said.

A European Union mission ended a similar visit on Tuesday and announced the EU's readiness to resume economic aid, which was interrupted five years ago to pressure Mobutu into respecting human rights and speeding democratic reforms.
